styles.name: Editorial Split Card
styles.idea: Oversized quote type over a deep forest field with a crisp receipt split widget.
styles.direction: Hero: shipped-app receipt card with 50/50 split bar. Palette: #1c2d22 field, #dfff88 accent band, #f5f5f0 card. Typography: heavy sans headline, tight leading 0.95. Motion: masked line reveals and bar fill.

styles.name: Circular Photo Cutout
styles.idea: Macro hand holding a receipt inside a hard circle mask with a tilted highlight sticker.
styles.direction: Hero: photographic hand holding receipt in warm window light, masked in a hard circle. Palette: #f4f6f0 field, #25362a type, #dfff88 sticker. Motion: circle iris and crisp wipe.

styles.name: Tactile Paper Receipt
styles.idea: Sculpted paper receipt tearing cleanly down the middle on a saturated lime field.
styles.direction: Hero: tactile craft paper receipt with crisp rules. Palette: #dfff88 field, #1e231d ink, #ffffff paper card. Motion: physical drop-in with subtle back.out settle.
